versions.content: DataConstr In general, the meta-class DataConstr can be referenced (via SwDataDefProps . dataConstr ) to define various constraints for the possible values of a data type. This includes limits for the physical and internal range, as well as special constraints ( monotony ) for the setup of axis definition.
